title: A grant typed in one session reaches the session it names
why: Owner, chat, Nov 1 22:37 CST: "a grant here should allow for a grant there". Auto mode in each session sees only grants typed in its own chat (incident: item 149 b, step runner-merge-allow).
note: Plan only. Lane session_013NEJL39Nqs8Q3RkY1N7Vz7, started Nov 1 22:55 CST. Covers step page-save-reaches-auto-mode's ask too; fold that step in if the plan does. Ready. Port: yes. Sighting 06:24 CST Nov 8: triage relayed the owner's chat words "lift it then for degen" to runner 9 as a grant; runner 9 refused it, since a lift needs the owner's words typed in the acting session. Same gap as item 412 a (a page pick or a relayed word is no grant where the act runs). Fix: a triage or coordinator relay of a grant names the acting session and gives the owner the exact line to type there, as a page task.
